Title: Another stupid Strike with Conviction question: Shadow of Taint

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Shadow of Taint, at [dom], says:
Move a card played by another Methuselah on an ally in your ready
region to another ally.

It doesn't say anything about requirements here.

If I have temporary control of an Imbued (say, with Art of Love), can I
play Shadow of Taint to move Strike with Conviction onto my War Ghoul?

If so, can my War Ghoul use that card?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> Shadow of Taint, at [dom], says:
> Move a card played by another Methuselah on an ally in your ready
> region to another ally.
>
> It doesn't say anything about requirements here.
>
> If I have temporary control of an Imbued (say, with Art of Love), can I
> play Shadow of Taint to move Strike with Conviction onto my War Ghoul?

No.
Treat it as if it has the "on whom the card could be played" text from
the [val].
